summary.text: Cas Garcia Hernandez is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 115 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as Cassandra Garcia Hernandez, a lawyer.

paragraphs.text: Cassandra Garcia Hernandez was born in Texas and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Houston and a law degree from the South Texas College of Law.
Her career experience includes working as a lawyer.
Garcia Hernandez assumed office in the Texas House on January 14, 2025, succeeding Julie Johnson, a Democrat.
Republican Danny Rosellini is also on the 2026 general election ballot for District 115.
In a Ballotpedia survey completed in 2023, she described herself as an experienced trial lawyer and community volunteer.
She said she was passionate about public safety, public education and reproductive rights.
